reuse.why: Extends the existing isWeekendOrHoliday predicate that every holiday check already goes through, using monthUtils.dayFromDate.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the MM-DD match is added once in a small isHoliday helper.

placement.why: The change lives in shared/schedules.ts next to the weekend/holiday predicate it refines.

scope.why: A three-line production change plus targeted tests; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Single, readable predicate that all callers (occurrence search, weekend solving) already share.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All holiday checks continue to flow through isWeekendOrHoliday.
